    enabled: true
    schema: platform::sysdig::1.0
    status: STAGING
    condition: >
      spawned_process and container
      and proc.name in (corpus_shells)
    lists:
      - name: corpus_shells
        items: [bash, sh, zsh]
    tags: [container, shell]
